description: The individual will install at site assembled air conditioning unit and refrigerators giving necessary power connections and making changes to units as necessary to attain desired results. Dismantles equipment partly or completely according to nature of defects to remove damaged or worn out parts, replaces or repairs defective parts, sets plant to desired cooling conditions, prevents leakage and ensures attainment and maintenance of required temperature.

Produce fitting jobs as per drawing (Range of operations: marking, sawing, filing, drilling, reaming).
Produce Sheet metal components (range of operation marking, metal cutting, bending, riveting and soldering etc.).
Identify electrical safety, measure power, currents, volts and earth resistance etc. connect single phase.

Perform gas welding, brazing, soldering observing related safety.
Identify RAC tools and equipment and recognise different parts of RAC system. Perform copper tube cutting, flaring, swaging, brazing.
Identify and test mechanical and electrical components. Perform leak test, vacuuming, gas charging, wiring and installation of refrigerator.

Check frost-free components; wiring and air distribution; leak detection, evacuation, gas charging.

Conduct servicing, backwash and re-generate water treatment plant of circulating water.
Perform fitting of expansion valve, adjustment of refrigerant flow according to heat load.
Perform servicing of evaporator and chillers.
Carry out servicing and retrofit of water cooler and dispenser.
Service, retrofit of visible cooler and bottle cooler and test performance.
Conduct servicing of deep freezer and test performance.

Repair, servicing and retrofit of ice candy plant.
Perform servicing of Ice plant and evaporative condenser.
Perform servicing and preventive maintenance of walk-in cooler and cold storage.

Perform servicing of motor and blowers used in different air conditioning system.
Construct, install, pack thermal and acoustic insulation of different air ducts.
Perform servicing and maintenance of different types of air filters.
Perform servicing, installation, fault diagnosis and remedial measures on Package AC.
Identify central AC components; test and wire electricals; service AHU/damper; check airflow; pump down gas.

Identify chilled water pipe line. Servicing of dampers, FCU and water control valves.
Troubleshoot central AC (DX and indirect); check controls; install major components; service all parts incl. cooling tower and water treatment.
Perform servicing of car AC, fault diagnosis and remedial measures.
Service, diagnose, repair mobile AC; leak test, evacuate, charge gas; check clutch, wiring; test performance.
